fact: On 28 February 2024 the President commissioned in Pointe-Noire the ARPCE-built Tier 3+ data centre, which the regulator says can host data of the public administration, the private sector and foreign companies that want to place equipment there.
title: Economie numérique : Denis Sassou N'Guesso connecte le Congo au câble 2Africa
publisher: Gouvernement de la République du Congo (gouvernement.cg)
